text: Hebr. he hath corrupted to himselfe. , Or, that they are not his children, that is their blot.
Or, hath burned. , Or, hath consumed.
Heb. from the chambers. , Heb. bereaue.
Or, our high hand and not the LORD hath done all this.
Or, is worse then the vine of Sodome. &c.
Or, praise his people ye nations. Or, sing ye. , Matt.7.6. rom.15.10.
Num. 10. 12, 13. and 27.14. , Or strife at Kadesh.
